use default

use CELL = (text: string, width: int, colour: string)

class NODE(text: string, children: LIST[NODE])

let outline =
    ["Display an outline as a nested table.",
     "    Parse the outline to a tree,",
     "        measuring the indent of each line,",
     "        translating the indentation to a nested structure,",
     "        and padding the tree to even depth.",
     "    count the leaves descending from each node,",
     "        defining the width of a leaf as 1,",
     "        and the width of a parent node as a sum.",
     "            (The sum of the widths of its children)",
     "    and write out a table with 'colspan' values",
     "        either as a wiki table,",
     "        or as HTML."]

let root_colour = "#ffffe6"
let palette = ["#ffebd2", "#f0fff0", "#e6ffff"]

margin(line: string) -> int =>
    line |> take_while(letter => letter == ' ') |> count()

parse(lines: List[string]) -> NODE is
    let unit = lines |> map(margin) |> filter(width => width > 0) |> min()
    let step = unit ?? 1
    let root = NODE(lines[0].trim(), LIST[NODE]())
    let ancestors = LIST[NODE]()

    ancestors.add(root)

    for line in lines |> skip(1) do
        let level = margin(line) / step
        let node = NODE(line.trim(), LIST[NODE]())

        while ancestors.count > level do
            ancestors.remove_at(ancestors.count - 1)
        od

        ancestors[ancestors.count - 1].children.add(node)
        ancestors.add(node)
    od

    root
si

deepest(node: NODE) -> int =>
    if node.children.count == 0 then
        0
    else
        (node.children |> map(deepest) |> max() ?? 0) + 1
    fi

pad(node: NODE, level: int, bottom: int) is
    if level < bottom /\ node.children.count == 0 then
        node.children.add(NODE("", LIST[NODE]()))
    fi

    for child in node.children do
        pad(child, level + 1, bottom)
    od
si

width(node: NODE) -> int =>
    if node.children.count == 0 then
        1
    else
        node.children
            |> map(width)
            |> reduce(0, (running, part) => running + part)
    fi

gather(node: NODE, level: int, colour: string,
       rows: LIST[LIST[CELL]])
is
    rows[level].add(
        (text = node.text, width = width(node), colour = colour))

    for entry in node.children |> index() do
        let shade =
            if level == 0 then
                palette[entry.index % palette.count]
            else
                colour
            fi

        gather(entry.value, level + 1, shade, rows)
    od
si

let tree = parse(outline)
let bottom = deepest(tree)

pad(tree, 0, bottom)

let rows = LIST[LIST[CELL]]()

for _ in 0::bottom do
    rows.add(LIST[CELL]())
od

gather(tree, 0, root_colour, rows)

write_line("{{| class=\"wikitable\" style=\"text-align: center;\"")

for row in rows do
    write_line("|-")

    for cell in row do
        if cell.text.length == 0 then
            write_line("|  | ")
        elif cell.width > 1 then
            write_line("| style=\"background: {cell.colour}; \" "
                       "colspan={cell.width} | {cell.text}")
        else
            write_line("| style=\"background: {cell.colour}; \" | "
                       "{cell.text}")
        fi
    od
od

write_line("|}}")
